collapse_initial: Use case: stylized-concept. Production-ready isolated game terrain sprite, transparent RGBA background. A few broken rusted iron beams mostly embedded in the upper-right mass, no wood wall, no intact building facade. Soft upper-left illumination, NO cast shadow baked outside silhouette, no ground/floor/base rectangle, no text, no border, no background/checkerboard painted in. All object silhouettes fully inside their cells with 10% transparent margin. Each sprite is a reusable independent environment prop. Rich hand-painted pixel-art-inspired texture, clean alpha, suited to a final display around 80x110 pixels for intact pillar and 80x60 pixels for broken pillar.
